pages.text: Drains let fluid leave the smeltery; a faucet attached to a drain pours that fluid into a casting table or basin below it.
A redstone signal on a faucet makes it pour automatically, so a smeltery wired to a casting table can cast a steady stream of parts without you clicking each time.
Drains also accept fluid pipes from other mods, letting you pump molten metal in and out of the structure for larger automated setups.
